correctness.rationale: Walk parametrization is an exhaustive bijection for n>=4. Balanced walks are exactly nonunits, so they total n*C(n,n/2). A commuting nontrivial rotation would make a balanced step sequence periodic with zero period sum, forcing an impossible translation equation. Reflection-fixed step involutions have rigorously counted paired and fixed edge signs and exactly two compatible basepoint values. Every nonunit stabilizer is trivial or a single reflection, so orbit-stabilizer yields exactly 2H orbits of size n and B/2-H of size 2n. The standard dihedral unit classes fill the polynomial. Odd n has only the units. Direct exact computational corroboration includes n=4,6,8,10,12 centralizers and Burnside totals, full orbit partitions n<=10, and brute all-function checks n=4,6; the general argument is analytic, not an extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The assessed statement is the full orbit-size polynomial for ALL endomorphisms of strict cycles under a SINGLE dihedral conjugating automorphism, plus the exact centralizers of every unit. In the full 2023 source, the equivalence used in Section 3 is explicitly f=u g v for independently chosen units, not conjugation, while its labeled totals and structure do not determine stabilizer sizes. The independently inspected 2026 rank-profile result counts individual maps by image size, not orbits. A previous idempotent-only orbit result is a strict subpopulation, not a dominating all-map theorem. The Michels–Knauer 2009 abstract concerns equivalence induced by KERNEL congruences, not conjugacy; its full text remains inaccessible and is recorded as residual risk. Exact published-finding corpus and literature searches identified no broader covering theorem, but absence of a hit is not treated as proof of priority.
residual_risks: Full text of Michels and Knauer (2009) was not obtained; an unpublished stronger statement could be present in that source.

value.rationale: Unit conjugacy of all monoid elements is a canonical algebraic invariant. The theorem provides an explicit complete orbit-size census for an infinite family, not a small isolated enumeration. Its sharp stabilizer dichotomy, parity-sensitive full unit-centralizer spectrum and exponentially rare nontrivial stabilizers describe structural symmetry information invisible to the known labeled count, image-rank histogram, and idempotent-only orbit theorem. This is a natural motivated complete classification, not an arbitrary slice or routine normalized check.
